content.short: Vesta Finance is a Layer 2-native CDP protocol on Arbitrum that issues the VST stablecoin with 0% interest.
content.description:
Vesta Finance is a leading decentralized lending protocol built natively for the Arbitrum network, designed to provide participants with a highly efficient and low-cost credit facility. The platform allows users to lock up various digital assets—including ETH, GMX, and DPX—to mint VST, an over-collateralized stablecoin. A standout feature of Vesta is its 0% interest rate on loans, instead charging a one-time minting and redemption fee, which provides users with total certainty over their long-term borrowing costs.

Designed for maximum capital efficiency, the protocol features low minimum collateralization ratios, enabling sophisticated traders to maximize their leverage within a secure and transparent environment. Vesta serves as a vital infrastructure layer for the Arbitrum DeFi ecosystem, providing the essential liquidity tools needed for project bootstrapping and sophisticated on-chain asset management. Through its commitment to non-custodial security and user-centric design, Vesta Finance is empowering participants to build more robust and inclusive decentralized portfolios with institutional-grade precision.
content.meta: Vesta Finance offers decentralized 0% interest lending and VST stablecoin issuance on the Arbitrum network.
